items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-09
items.q: Now he's promoting Tom Brown, who is recording and who is a member, and got 30 pieces of silver in the form of a loving cup, like Judas Iscariot got when he sold Christ.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's all right. Well, I guess we're about to take. It'll run out, but that's all right.

This letter he is about to read now. I've come across it by accident. It will show a man how he spoke out of both sides of his mouth. 1949, he said that there was no other band. Now he's promoting Tom Brown, who is recording and who is a member, and got 30 pieces of silver in the form of a loving cup, like Judas Iscariot got when he sold Christ. Would you please read that article from Mr. Sushant?
All right. This is the letter. The heading is... No dating on it. Dr. Edmond Sushant. No all names there.
